cli.flag.bot_default: bot username (default: read from the bot session)
cli.flag.fix: repair the index from the check result
cli.flag.force: overwrite the existing file at the target path
cli.flag.rebuild: rebuild the index from full node history
cli.flag.to: target volume, empty means the same volume
cli.usage:
Usage:
  mytgfs version    print version and runtime (supports --json)
  mytgfs auth bot   log in with a bot token
  mytgfs auth user  log in with a phone number (code prompted at runtime)
  mytgfs channel init --bot <username>  create a private channel and promote the bot
  mytgfs volume create --name <name>  create a volume: channel, bot, muted notifications
  mytgfs volume delete --name <name>  delete a volume: channel, config entry, local index
  mytgfs volume check  verify every volume's channel
  mytgfs ls [--name VOL] [DIR]  list a directory
  mytgfs mkdir [--name VOL] <DIR>  create a directory
  mytgfs rm [--name VOL] <PATH...>  delete files or directories (recursive)
  mytgfs mv [--name VOL] <SRC> <DST>  move or rename
  mytgfs get [--name VOL] <REMOTE> [LOCAL|-]  download a file
  mytgfs search [--name VOL] [--dir DIR] [--limit N] <QUERY>  search by file name
  mytgfs cp [--name VOL] [--to DST_VOL] [--force] <SRC> <DST>  copy by reference
  mytgfs put [--name VOL] [--remote /dir] <LOCAL...>  upload files or directories
  mytgfs sync [--rebuild]  apply channel updates, or rebuild the index from all nodes
  mytgfs check [--name VOL] [--fix]  compare index with channel and repair
  mytgfs config show|get|set|keys  read/write config (same as the panel)
  mytgfs web [--port N]  local web panel (port defaults to [web].port)
  mytgfs tray  system tray: auto sync, panel
  mytgfs startup enable|disable|status  run at login (off by default)

Environment:
  MYTGFS_API_ID  override api_id
  MYTGFS_PHONE   phone number for user login
  MYTGFS_2FA     optional 2FA password for user login
  MYTGFS_LANG    force a language
err.auth_lost_hint: session is no longer valid; log in again: mytgfs auth bot / mytgfs auth user
err.get_stdout_json: cannot stream file content to stdout in --json mode; give a local output path
err.autostart_unsupported: autostart is not supported on this platform
err.bot_no_username: this bot has no username; set one in BotFather first
err.bot_not_ready: bot session is not ready yet; check the connection and try again
err.bot_username_empty: bot username must not be empty
err.channel_admin_required: this operation requires the bot to be a channel admin
err.channel_check_no_post: the bot is a member but has no posting rights; make it an admin again
err.channel_check_unknown: cannot read the bot participant info in this channel
err.channel_created_bot_failed: channel %d was created but adding the bot failed
err.channel_hint: %s (%s). Run mytgfs volume check to inspect the volume
err.channel_id_empty: channel id must not be empty
err.channel_invalid: channel id is invalid or the channel was deleted
err.channel_missing: channel %d does not exist or is not accessible
err.channel_not_in_list: channel %d is not in the current user channel list
err.channel_not_visible: channel %d is not visible: it may be deleted or the bot was removed. Run mytgfs volume check
err.channel_private: the bot is not a member of this channel, or the channel is private and unreachable
err.channel_unavailable: channel %d does not exist or the bot has not joined
err.channels_unavailable: listing channels is unavailable here, enter the chat id manually
err.chat_write_forbidden: the bot cannot post in this channel; make it an admin again
err.code_send_failed: the login code was not sent, try again later
err.cp_dst_exists: destination already exists, use --force to overwrite: %s
err.cp_same_path: source and destination are the same path
err.cp_src_missing: source is not in the index, run mytgfs sync first: %s
err.dav_dir_into_self: cannot move a directory into its own subtree
err.dav_not_write: file is not opened for writing
err.diff_rounds_exceeded: sync: too many difference rounds (%d, pts=%d)
err.login_unavailable: signing in from the panel is unavailable here
err.missing_api_id: Missing api_id: set it in config.toml [telegram] or MYTGFS_API_ID
err.name_too_long: file or folder name is too long (max %d bytes)
err.peer_id_invalid: channel peer is invalid; the stored chat_id may be stale
err.phone_required: phone number with country code is required
err.session_missing: no login session yet, sign in first
err.too_large: file exceeds the Telegram single-message limit
err.upload_incomplete: Upload is incomplete and cannot be committed
err.upload_no_session: Upload session is missing or expired
err.upload_offset: Chunk offset mismatch, resync and retry
err.upload_part_rejected: server did not confirm the part
err.user_banned_in_channel: the bot is banned in this channel
err.user_session_missing: no user session yet: run mytgfs auth login once
err.volume_attach_prefix: failed to attach the existing channel
err.volume_attach_unavailable: attaching an existing channel is unavailable here
err.volume_chat_id_invalid: invalid channel id, expected -100... or bare id
err.volume_config_remove_prefix: removing the volume from the config failed
err.volume_name_empty: volume name must not be empty
err.volume_name_newline: volume name must not contain a newline
err.volume_no_channel: volume %s has no channel id configured
err.volume_not_found: no volume named %s in the config
log.autostart_read_failed: failed to read the autostart state
log.cleanup_acked: failed to clear the upload record (index retry is idempotent)
log.dedup_fallback: dedup reuse failed, falling back to upload
log.delete_old_msg: failed to delete the overwritten message
log.fsck_rebuilt: index rebuilt from channel full node list
log.pending_resume_failed: pending upload failed, keeping record for retry: %s: %v
log.rebuild_done: index rebuilt from channel full node list
log.remote_gone: remote message was deleted, cleaning the index
log.resume_delete: failed to delete the upload checkpoint
log.resume_save: failed to save the upload checkpoint
log.tmp_sweep_failed: failed to sweep upload temp files
tray.state.auth_lost: credentials expired, please log in again
volume.check_ok: ok: the bot can read and write the channel
volume.restart_hint: restart the tray for the new volume to take effect
warn.diff_too_long: warning: the difference is too large, only recent changes were applied; the index was rebuilt
